verdict: Paid ads are paused; organic signals are carrying the load but fading.
narrative: No spend ran on Meta or Google Ads during the last 28 days, so every engagement Maadi Law received came entirely from organic sources — your Google Business Profile and Instagram. Your GBP delivered 93 total actions this period (calls, direction requests, and web clicks), but those actions dropped 40% in the most recent 7 days versus the prior 7, with the last few days showing the sharpest decline. Instagram reach fell nearly 38% week-over-week as well, confirming this is a broader organic softening, not an isolated data point. Paid campaigns are being reactivated to restore a reliable lead source and take pressure off organic channels. You should expect lead flow to resume once ads are back in market.
